searchText: In my journeys I discovered that `SECONDS_PER_DAY` must be eq/gt `SECONDS_PER_ETH1_BLOCK * ETH1_FOLLOW_DISTANCE * 2` otherwise `new_eth1.data.len() > all_eth1_data.len()`. The Python impl raises an assertion in this case.
